description: Open paper packaging the way a sales clerk or a person at home does: take a factory-flat laminated rope-handle gift bag from a stack, open it, square its block bottom, drop in a bottom board and stand it on the counter mat (and put a boxed candle in it); take the telescoping lid off a two-piece gift box without the air film dragging the base up; tear the taped wrapping paper off a present; open a sealed corrugated supply carton at a back-room receiving table by removing its packing-tape seam and folding its four creased flaps open.
count_scope: Nine named tasks; the original six retain their bare selections and default meanings. Three appended tasks. The eight-task set selects new contracts explicitly.

evaluator.scope: Simulator state only: bag rim hull, bottom flatness, gusset crease angles, board and candle placement, lid overlap and base lift/tilt history, paper coverage of the box, seam-tape bond state and flap angles of the carton with carton and contents displacement, robot contact over a 3 s hands-off window. No autonomous-solution claim.

qualification: Contact world 2026-10-07b. Shown: home/lift-lid by two unassisted FR3 arms at 1 cm/s (at 10 cm/s the lid slips out of the squeeze in five runs of five); receiving/open-carton with phantom assistance, by peeling the seam tape (no knife is modelled), evaluator success in three runs. NOT shown: counter/open-bag and counter/bag-purchase (with the holds of two hands the mouth opens without a tear but the block bottom does not square; the openings that reach the goal state guide 2,760 of the tote's 3,559 vertices and used an incorrect friction model); home/unwrap-gift and home/open-present (phantom hands peel the end tape and open the end; nine attempts to get the paper off by sliding or tearing failed). No robot has opened the tote, unwrapped the present or opened the carton. Not established: whether an opened but unworked tote passes the two gusset checks (140 degrees with the board crease law, 93 with the paper-class law; the limit is 120). Known defects of the world: the wrapped present's start state is made without its photo frame, so its end tapes hold 6-7.5 N at rest; a 180 degree packing-tape peel is four times too strong; paper in contact runs far above 200x wall/sim. Friction is Coulomb's law with rest, checked on a tilted plane; paper, crease, tape, tear and air-film physics are component-qualified by benches.

task_set.score_rule: 1 on success; otherwise 0.9 x continuous task progress; untouched start 0. bag-purchase keeps its original evaluator unchanged.
task_set.status: Code and stub tests only: the task set is not yet run with the simulator or render-checked.
task_set.selection_notes: open-present stays registered outside the eight. The recorded routes for open-bag and unwrap-gift failed, which does not show that every strategy fails; both are kept with that risk. bag-candle keeps the bag's factory crease memory and does not reset the creases to a worked state.
